incidents.body:
We are pleased to confirm that the service disruption affecting Messaging & Live Chat has been fully resolved. All services are fully operational.
The root cause was identified as a Google Cloud Platform infrastructure issue which has since been remediated by their engineering team.
We sincerely apologize for the disruption and thank you for your patience.
incidents.title: Messaging & Live Chat platform Outage

incidents.body:
Update – November 3, 2025
 Performance across TeamSupport has now returned to normal, and systems are operating as expected.
Our engineering team is continuing to investigate the root cause, which appears to be related to an upstream dependency, though this has not yet been fully confirmed.
We’ll share a final update once our investigation is complete. Thank you for your patience while we worked through this issue.
incidents.title: Performance slowness Identified!
One of our Service Providers experienced an outage starting at 2:30 AM CST. The outage appears to be resolving itself
